The '''Saber's Tooth''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located at the [[Yefowr]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Taskeed/Legends|Taskeed]]. A halfway-respectable establishment, it smelt strongly of [[carababba tabac]] and intoxicants. It had a lively [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] scene, with patrons able to play [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], [[Nierer's folly]], [[two-hand]], and [[dootch]]. [[Celia Durasha]] and [[Kaj Nedmak]] met with [[Bwahl]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in the Saber's Tooth to pick up a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] run to [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]].<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref>
